workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots they both have free next week:
Mon: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM
Tue: 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM, 4:30 PM
Wed: 3:00 PM, 3:30 PM
Thu: 10:00 AM, 2:30 PM
Fri: 11:00 AM, 11:30 AM

Please check if any of these work for Elena and David. If you find one, let me know and I'll book it. Let's try to get this done as quickly as we can.
